source.title: Samus Aran (Power Suit)
observed: whole commissioned source evidence records dense full-character pose families plus a detached component/tile bank
static sheet layout does not establish playback chronology or exposure duration
inferred: reaction-bar/puck task abstraction and resulting authored recoil performance

primitive: unsupported midair reaction impulse changes root velocity before crossed ground catch
causal_chain: preload -> clean ballistic rise -> unsupported task pulse -> opposite root-vector bend -> gravity descent -> separated crossed-foot contact -> one-foot crush -> late second support -> task overshoot -> displaced settle

keys.label: LOAD CROUCH
keys.causal_role: grounded asymmetrical preload stores vertical and task-axis energy
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root low and rear-biased; no air support

keys.label: TOE RELEASE
keys.causal_role: last grounded support drives root upward/right before release
keys.motion_arc_root_note: left toe is last support; root accelerates away from ground

keys.label: RISE EXTEND
keys.causal_role: unsupported ballistic rise establishes clean pre-task flight
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root travels right/up; feet clear support

keys.label: AIR TASK COIL
keys.causal_role: task folds across torso while root remains ballistic
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root still right/up but vertical gain decays; task has not changed root yet

keys.label: APEX PRE-PULSE
keys.causal_role: apex read freezes task intention before the free-flight impulse
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root nearly flat at apex; task line compresses toward left shoulder

keys.label: REACTION PULSE
keys.causal_role: puck ejection creates an authored opposite task impulse while body remains unsupported
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root reaches last rightward sample; impulse changes subsequent horizontal velocity, not support

keys.label: RECOIL FOLD
keys.causal_role: task impulse folds shoulders left while legs scissor to absorb angular debt
keys.motion_arc_root_note: horizontal root gain collapses; gravity owns vertical descent

keys.label: VECTOR BEND
keys.causal_role: free-flight root visibly bends left/down after the task impulse
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root reverses horizontal drift without wall/platform/ground support

keys.label: DESCENT CROSS-PREP
keys.causal_role: legs reorganize for an asymmetric crossed catch before any ground support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root continues left/down; right foot crosses body midline toward landing lane

keys.label: SEPARATED PRECONTACT
keys.causal_role: one-frame air gap makes support acquisition legible before crossed foot catch
keys.motion_arc_root_note: right foot hovers one row above floor; root still descending

keys.label: CROSS-FOOT CONTACT
keys.causal_role: crossed right foot acquires ground support while pelvis is still above and left of it
keys.motion_arc_root_note: contact occurs under the opposite side of the body; root continues down after contact

keys.label: ONE-FOOT CRUSH
keys.causal_role: new crossed support pays remaining vertical and leftward debt through deep one-sided compression
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root drops and slides left of support; free foot remains late

keys.label: REAR FOOT HUNT
keys.causal_role: free foot hunts around the crossed stance instead of teleporting to bilateral support
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root stays loaded on right foot; shoulders and bar overrun rightward

keys.label: SECOND CONTACT
keys.causal_role: late left foot earns bilateral support after one-foot crush
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root lifts slightly but remains displaced; support topology changes only now

keys.label: SHOULDER OVERRUN
keys.causal_role: upper-body/task lag passes beyond the now-stabilizing pelvis
keys.motion_arc_root_note: pelvis decelerates while shoulders and bar overshoot left

keys.label: DISPLACED SETTLE
keys.causal_role: stance restacks without returning to launch pose or original world position
keys.motion_arc_root_note: root settles left of launch trajectory with wide asymmetric stance and residual task angle

revision.persistence_defect: current main had build/contact/manifest only; motion.json, SPA, receipt absent; persisted build canvas also disagreed with manifest media dimensions

tango_rounds.inspection: actual 57-frame render shows asymmetric preload and toe release, clean unsupported rise, visible puck ejection, root-vector bend left/down without support, crossed-foot precontact/contact, deep one-foot crush, late second support, upper-body/bar overrun, and displaced settle

noodle_queen.inspection: task impulse visibly owns the midair direction change; the crooked crossed catch pays recoil and gravity debt; recovery hunts/restacks instead of reversing to launch pose; silhouette progression is specific rather than generic jump dressing
